note: A synthetic client (Slice 116 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We want an internal audit of employee expense claims. Last year we paid 4,800 claims and we suspect approvals are weak.

answers.common.decision: Whether to tighten the expense policy; the CFO decides.
answers.common.audience: The CFO and the audit committee.
answers.common.materials: In a sample of 120 claims, 18 had no manager approval and 6 exceeded the policy limit.
answers.risk-audit-controls.scope: All expense claims paid last year.
